2026_03_ARI_SF.headline: Arizona’s new-look offense meets San Francisco’s restored defensive core in an NFC West test
2026_03_ARI_SF.paragraph1: Arizona enters the divisional matchup trying to establish a steadier identity around Jacoby Brissett, a deep backfield and Marvin Harrison Jr., while San Francisco’s ceiling still depends on keeping its veteran core available. The Cardinals need efficient early-down offense to keep the 49ers’ pass rush from dictating the game. San Francisco can answer by leaning on Christian McCaffrey, forcing Arizona to tackle in space and creating manageable situations for Brock Purdy.
2026_03_ARI_SF.model_rationale: Arizona’s path depends on staying ahead of the chains, while San Francisco can stress the Cardinals by combining efficient rushing with a healthier defensive front.
